name: selectedCount
description: Number of currently selected items. Rendered in the count label and used by aria-live to announce selection changes.

name: hasSelection
description: Controls visibility. True slides the bar up into view; false slides it down and disables pointer events.

name: actions
description: Ordered action buttons. Each action has id, label, optional icon, variant, and an onClick that may return a Promise — per-action loading state is handled automatically.

name: onClearSelection
description: Invoked when the user hits the Clear / X button to deselect all items.

name: className
description: Extra classes applied to the fixed-position outer wrapper.
